hotels.title: Crete Boutique Adults-Only Hideaway with Private Pool & Bath House
hotels.description: Carved into Crete’s dramatic limestone cliffs, this adults-only sanctuary reveals cave-style suites with private pools that appear to spill into the Aegean. Four designer dining spaces echo the earthy architecture, from a cobblestone-arched pool bar pouring crafted drinks to Cremnos, where modern Greek plates are served against sweeping clifftop views. Umi delivers traditional felights from Peru and Japan, while Caléa by Gerardo Metta and Eleonas showcase Greek-Italian and Cretan flavours on the cliffside. The Bath House, inspired by the heritage of ancient Greek bathing rituals, offer steam rituals and soothing soaks rooted in tradition. Asana Wellness Club brings together a serene yoga shala, fully equipped fitness centre and reformer pilates studio, with curated programmes designed by resident experts in movement and holistic health.
